item.text:
The architecture ontology in this project is **not** a temporary hand-written stub; it is a **generated production ontology**.  
As recorded in the M2 architectural decisions (“**Trivyn-generated production ontology delivered; stub ontology retired (M2)**” and related rationale), commit `7f015a32` removed the stub and installed the Trivyn-generated ontology (`ontologies/software-architecture.ttl`), so the project is currently on the production generated version.
